name: Vision-Taiwan-595k
description: A large-scale image dataset collected from Taiwan containing ~595k images intended for vision model training and evaluation across regional scenarios. It captures diverse scenes and visual concepts representative of Taiwanese contexts and can be used for tasks like image classification, detection, and retrieval. The dataset emphasizes regional coverage rather than a single benchmarked task.
reputation: Relatively new and region-specific dataset with limited but growing use for Taiwan-focused vision research and transfer-learning studies.
